directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动30型混凝土泵的理论输送量写成12–15 m³/h，把最大出口压力写成20 MPa。电动30型混凝土泵这一页把理论输送量写成12–15 m³/h，把最大出口压力单独写成20 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_fluid。

body.en: Picture source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_fluid. Subject: Hydraulic fluid. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 30 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Output Capacity 12–15 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 20 MPa. On the Electric 30 Concrete Pump sheet, Output Capacity is 12–15 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 20 MPa. Fine Stone Pumping (H / V) 60 m / 180 m. Stroke length, cycle rate and price are absent from both the caption and this catalogue row. Fine Stone Pumping (H / V) 60 m / 180 m.
body.zh: 图片来源：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_fluid。画面主体：Hydraulic fluid。河北品锦机械在邢台把电动30型混凝土泵的理论输送量写成12–15 m³/h，把最大出口压力写成20 MPa。河北品锦机械不把这句说明当成电动30型混凝土泵的铭牌。细石输送（水平/垂直） 60 m / 180 m。

body.en: Output is a volume rate. A number in m³/h is a volume rate, and a number in MPa is pressure. Main-unit weight is 1200 kg. The Xingtai row does not list a service interval, a seal torque, an export destination or a job case. Main-unit weight is 1200 kg.
body.zh: 电动30型混凝土泵这一页把理论输送量写成12–15 m³/h，把最大出口压力单独写成20 MPa。行程、冲次和价格在说明文字和这一行目录里都没有。

body.en: Pressure is a separate entry on the same sheet. Hopper capacity is 0.3 m³. Its subject is Piston pump delivery. Hopper capacity is 0.3 m³. Those shown extras are still not a stroke length.
body.zh: 细石输送（水平/垂直） 60 m / 180 m。邢台这一行没有标出保养小时间隔、密封扭矩、出口国家或工程案例。

question.en: What output does the Electric 30 Concrete Pump sheet list?
question.zh: 电动30型混凝土泵这一页的输送量标出多少？

answer.en: Output Capacity is 12–15 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_fluid.
answer.zh: 理论输送量是12–15 m³/h。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_fluid画面里印出的数字。

question.en: What pressure entry is on the same sheet?
question.zh: 同一页的压力格是多少？

answer.en: Max. Outlet Pressure is 20 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_fluid.
answer.zh: 最大出口压力是20 MPa。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_fluid画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: No. The sheet leaves stroke length, cycle rate and price unprinted. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_fluid.
answer.zh: 没有。这一页没有标出行程、冲次和价格。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_fluid画面里印出的数字。
